The **gold nanorods (AuNRs)** had an average length of **90 nm** and a smooth surface (Fig. S1). The **helical gold nanorods (HGNRs)** made from them had an average length of **126 nm**, with a rod-like shape and a well-defined helical shell (Fig. 1a, S2). (Page 3, Section 3.1)

That works out to about 36 nm of added length from the helical shell grown during synthesis.
